project: FiveM + Discord Vehicle Ownership System - Discord Bot Layer
scope: This layer handles all Discord-facing vehicle ownership operations, including import commands, ownership assignment, driver whitelisting, vehicle listing, DM notifications, and staff logging.
corePurpose: Provide a Discord command suite that lets staff and owners manage FiveM vehicle ownership records through a shared SQL-backed system.
responsibilities: Receive staff commands for vehicle import and ownership management
Send authenticated requests to the FiveM server or HTTP endpoint
Display vehicle ownership information in Discord embeds and menus
Manage interactive buttons and selection workflows
Notify players by DM when ownership changes or vehicles are imported

importvehicle.description: Import a vehicle into the ownership system for a Discord user.
expectedOutcome: Owner receives a DM with the spawn code

myvehicles.description: List the vehicles currently owned or accessible by the requesting Discord user.
expectedOutcome: Bot queries the SQL-backed vehicle registry
Bot displays a paginated or interactive list of vehicles
Each vehicle entry can open an action menu

assignvehicle.description: Transfer ownership of a vehicle to another player.
expectedOutcome: Previous owner receives a transfer confirmation

adddriver.description: Whitelist a user as an allowed driver for a vehicle.

removedriver.description: Remove a previously whitelisted driver from a vehicle.

revertownership.description: Restore the original ownership state of a vehicle.

buttons.assign: Send transfer request to the FiveM server

responseHandling: Surface Discord-friendly success or failure messages

notifications.dmOnImport: Vehicle Ownership Assigned — Spawn Code: gtr
notifications.dmOnTransfer: Vehicle Ownership Assigned — Spawn Code: gtr — Given by George

logging.logDestination: Configured Discord log channel or admin logging webhook

securityRequirements: Validate that only authorized staff can import or transfer vehicles
Verify the target Discord user exists before sending ownership data
Use a shared secret between Discord bot and FiveM server
Never trust Discord-only input without server-side verification
